description: This file contains EFI-related GPIO code, including class definitions for managing engine pins, functions for initializing, starting, stopping, and unregistering GPIO pins, and macros for setting pin values. It references external hardware and engine components, and defines specific pin configurations for ignition, injection, and auxiliary valves.

classes.name: EnginePins
classes.description: Manages engine-related GPIO pins, including initialization, starting, stopping, and resetting pins for ignition, injection, and auxiliary valves.

classes.name: OutputPin
classes.description: Represents a generic GPIO output pin with methods to initialize, set, toggle, and get the logic state.

classes.name: NamedOutputPin
classes.description: Extends OutputPin with a name and methods to set high/low states, and stop the pin.

classes.name: InjectorOutputPin
classes.description: Specialized output pin for injectors, with reset and stop functionalities.

classes.name: IgnitionOutputPin
classes.description: Specialized output pin for ignition coils, with reset functionality.

methods.name: EnginePins::stopPins
methods.description: Stops all engine pins (coils, injectors, auxiliary valves).

methods.name: EnginePins::unregisterPins
methods.description: Unregisters all engine pins from their outputs.

methods.name: NamedOutputPin::setHigh
methods.description: Sets the pin to high (active) state.

methods.name: NamedOutputPin::setLow
methods.description: Sets the pin to low (inactive) state.

methods.name: OutputPin::setValue
methods.description: Sets the logic value of the pin, considering hardware mode.

methods.name: OutputPin::toggle
methods.description: Toggles the current logic state of the pin.
